description: Spinners pop in where the work starts, then the ring turns at a steady pace while its arc stretches and shrinks, the one part allowed to keep moving.
moves: It lands with a pop from 0.4 when it appears, usually in place of a label.
The ring turns at a steady pace while its arc stretches and shrinks; the spokes fade one after another around the dial.

propDocs.Spinner.label: What a screen reader hears. Defaults to "Loading".
propDocs.Spinner.variant: The drawing: "ring", an arc that turns and stretches, or "spokes", eight spokes fading round.
propDocs.Spinner.speed: How fast it turns: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
